observations: Three photos show a metallic automotive part with a circular base and four mounting holes, placed on a concrete surface.
The part has a black plastic or rubber insert with two protruding studs and a central hole.
A small circular mark with a star inside is visible on the metal surface, possibly a manufacturer's logo or part number.
The part appears to be made of cast metal, likely aluminum or steel, with some surface wear and grime.
No visible brand or model markings are readable on the part itself in any photo.
The seller claims it is a 'high grade tokunbo gear seat/mount for Gle, Ml 350(2012) upwards'.
